ops.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate this route? Existing bookings and flight records remain.

recording.title: ACARS recording evidence
recording.trust: Client recordings are supporting evidence, not proof of a real flight. Flags require independent review; online status is a pilot declaration.
recording.retention: Completed raw tracks are retained for 90 days. Incomplete or aborted recordings expire after 30 days of inactivity. Summary and flags remain with the report.
recording.unavailable: Raw samples are unavailable or have expired. The report summary is retained.
recording.plotHelp: Geographic track only, without external map tiles. Missing positions and telemetry gaps are not connected. This is not a navigation chart.
recording.sampled: This large track is sampled for display (at most 4,096 points). Download NDJSON for the full evidence.
recording.legend: Filled dot: first displayed point. Open circle: last displayed point. Breaks represent missing or discontinuous telemetry.
recording.noPositions: No valid recorded positions are available.
recording.noAccess: Recording access is unavailable. Your session or review permission may have changed. Reload after signing in or checking your permissions.
recording.indexHelp: Only your recordings appear here, including unsubmitted flights. Personal exports contain this authenticated download index, not inline tracks or permanent public links. Create bookings on the website; uploading a recording does not file or approve a PIREP.
